bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears traded defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. to the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for cornerback Clark Phillips III as the team finalized its roster ahead of the season opener.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions announced 14 additions to their practice squad on Monday, finalizing their roster depth ahead of the 2026 regular season. The Detroit Lions signed 14 players to their 2026 practice squad on Monday, including quarterback Luke Altmyer, cornerback Nick Whiteside, and wide receiver Tom Kennedy, all of whom had just missed the initial 53-man roster cut.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is running back Josh Jacobs, who has been placed on the Commissioner's Exempt list pending an investigation into alleged domestic violence charges . This comes as the Packers finalize their 53-man roster, having also completed a trio of trades that included acquiring backfield depth from Pittsburgh and dealing QB Kyle McCord for a 2028 sixth-round pick .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings agreed to sign veteran outside linebacker Kyle Van Noy on Tuesday night, a 35-year-old with 57 career sacks who will provide Minnesota with needed depth and experience at edge rusher . The move addresses a thin pass-rush rotation after Jonathan Greenard was traded to the Philadelphia Eagles for salary cap savings in April, and second-year prospect Tyler Batty suffered a season-ending knee injury in the final exhibition game , with Van Noy reuniting with defensive coordinator Brian Flores, for whom he won two Super Bowls in New England.
